Humanoids

UND plans production-version MAGBOT mobile humanoid debut at Roboworld

The design combines Hanwha dual arms, a 500 kg-class AMR base and magnetic tool changing.

Robot Newspaper ↗28 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2

Production version planned

UND Robotics reports Tier-1 registration with a major Korean company and plans a production-version modular humanoid debut at November’s Roboworld after showing a draft at FIX 2026. The customer and contracted robot quantities are not named.

Mobile base and interchangeable tools

The design combines two Hanwha arms with MAGBOT magnetic tool changers, for which UND cites 0.2-second switching. Its independently driven and steered four-wheel AMR base is in the 500 kg class; that is not the payload of each arm.

Harsh-environment ambitions need qualification

UND targets battery, ESS and hydrogen manufacturing, mentioning heat, water and explosion-protection requirements without listing complete-system certifications. This does not establish every rating for every model. An 80 kg-class slim lifting AMR and mixed-robot management are also described.
